Nudgelings for macOS

A tiny crew that lives in your menu bar and gently bullies you into being healthy.

Download v{{VERSION}} ({{SIZE}})

macOS 14 or later · Apple Silicon and Intel · free, no account, works offline

How to install
  1. Open the downloaded file and drag Nudgelings onto Applications.
  2. Open Nudgelings from Applications. macOS says it can't check the app, because it's an indie build without Apple's paid notarisation. Click Done.
  3. Open System Settings › Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway. On macOS 14 you can instead right-click the app and choose Open. You only do this once.
  4. The welcome tour takes about 40 seconds. After that the crew lives in your menu bar, top right.
